heading.text: Gunline — capital ship squadron battle mockup

howto.text: Press Play on the battle board. You command the Concord squadron (Resolute + Vigilant). Click inside the blue zone to plot the selected ship's course and pick an order (Ram included); switch ships with the fleet buttons or by clicking them. Double-click plots and moves on to the next ship, and commits on the last. All ships move at once; in gunnery you roll your own dice in the dice tray, and decide on boarding actions when an enemy's shields are down and its hull is below half. Hover a damage tag to see the rolls. Tweaks panel: hot-seat. The campaign board (right) lets you click through the operation map and try the drydock refit screen.
